text:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH severity — GPU pool saturation detected in sa-east1. Autoscaler observed repeated 'quota denied' on scale-up requests. Queue length growing > 1200. Trigger: autoscaler-rate-limit.
devon: saw this hit the dashboard, queue spiked ~10m ago. customer-facing errors = 502s for some dedicated hosts.
alyssa: oncall here. ack. adding context — we have fairshare + reserved capacity for enterprise tenants in this region, looks like quota hard cap for project 'redwood-prod-sa' returned 403 on N1 GPU create.
marco: confirming GCP quota error in logs: `quotaExceeded: Your project exceeded the quota for accelerators: GPUs.` full trace: `compute.instances.insert -> 403 Quota exceeded`.
sara: any immediate customer impact? support is getting DMs about requests timing out. Ticket #INC-4921 is already open.
devon: impact: hosted API median latency unchanged for other regions, but requests pinned to sa-east1 have 20-40% error rate depending on pool. Some Dedicated customers using region pinning see errors.
alyssa: first mitigation steps: 1) reduce min replicas for non-critical pools in sa-east1 to free claimed GPUs. 2) enable failover routing for customer-tier=dev to us-central1. 3) drop batch sizes for streaming routes to reduce GPU claims. Doing step 1 now.
marco: manual command to shrink pool:```sh
rctl scale pool gpu-pool-sa-east1 --min 0 --max 6
```
marco: ran shrink, saw ~18 jobs evicted, autoscaler attempted to create 5 instances and got 403.
devon: routing change queued — flipping dynamic routing policy to prefer us-central for non-data-residency customers. Command: `kubectl apply -f routing/sa-fallback.yaml`
ops-bot: deploy-bot: route policy change applied to routing-service (rev 2026-03-15_03) :white_check_mark:
alyssa: ok routing change live. monitoring queue now — sa-east1 queue length dropping slowly from 1200 -> 800.
sara: sending customer comms draft to CC: impacted: some enterprise clusters + a subset of hosted requests. Draft: "We're experiencing degraded capacity in South America due to cloud quota limits; traffic is being rerouted and errors may persist for up to 30 minutes." Any edits?
devon: add: "no data lost, requests will be retried or served from fallback region; teams with strict data residency may continue to see errors."
sara: will send.
marco: I reached out to GCP quota team via support console, escalation number 987654321. They responded with ETA 45-90 mins.
alyssa: longer-term mitigation while quota request pending: 1) temporarily reassign warm pools from lower-priority projects to production (manual claim). 2) enable model-quantization fallback for non-critical models to reduce GPU mem footprint. I'll open a hot change.
devon: we should also lower per-tenant concurrency caps in region to avoid new requests queuing. Patch applied: `config set region.sa-east1.max_concurrency 8`
alyssa: concurrency cap applied. queue growth rate slowed. good.
marco: performing manual warm-pool steal: ran `pool-transfer --from=research-sa --to=prod-sa --gpus=8` -> success, those VMs show now attached.
ops-bot: metric alert: sa-east1 error-rate down to 12% from 40% :chart_with_downwards_trend:
devon: still seeing some tail latency; hosted customers with region preference still getting 504s for long-run jobs. We're throttling long-run requests ( >120s ) to queue them for retry in fallback region.
sara: customer notice sent to affected customers. Support triage routing set to high.
alyssa: timeline update for incident channel and PagerDuty: initial detection 1718246800, mitigation actions started 1718246860, routing change complete 1718246940, manual pool reassign at 1718247060, queue significantly reduced at 1718247300.
marco: GCP replied: they can increase quota after validating billing and usage; gave soft approval, formal increase ETA ~ 1h. They suggested switching to a different accelerator type if we need immediate capacity.
devon: can we hot-switch a fraction of workloads to A2 GPUs with config `model_variant: a2-compatible` ? Risk: slight perf regress but instant capacity.
alyssa: approving conservative switch for non-critical routes. marco, roll out a canary of 10% of traffic to a2-variant in sa-east1.
marco: will do. canary commands:```yaml
- route: streaming-gen
  variant: a2-compatible
  weight: 10
```
marco: canary up. initial health checks pass. CPU/GPU mem stable.
ops-bot: alert: queue now 180 and decaying :white_check_mark: 
devon: beginning handoff to morning oncall (alyssa -> devon is night to morning; but oncall rotation: @alyssa handing to @marco for next shift).@marco you taking next?
marco: I'll stay on until quota bump confirmed. handing to day oncall @lina at 1718247400. Lina not in channel yet.
alyssa: post-incident actions: - follow up with GCP quota owner to confirm permanent quota increase - add automatic region fallback for critical tenant policies - write runbook for 'quota denial' autoscaler behavior - add telemetry to detect rising quota rejections earlier.
sara: support: create CSAT follow-ups only for customers who had dedicated cluster errors.
devon: closing note: no data corruption, no persisted job loss, majority of requests recovered by rerouting & manual reassign. keep eyes on GCP ticket 987654321.
incident-bot: Incident closed as 'mitigated' at 1718247425 by alyssa. Summary pinned to channel. :white_check_mark:
